div.head: IV Eg 9
div.ab: Gif hit þonne ofer V niht ungecyd on gemænre læse wunað, þolige þæs orfes swa we ær cwædon, ⁊ þara hyrda ælc ðolige ðære hyde, ⁊ ðæs ne sy nan forgyfnes, gesecan þæt hi gesecan; ⁊ he ðeahhwæðere cyðe on hwæs gewytnesse he þæt orf bohte.

If, however, it remains unnotified on the common pasture for more than five days, he shall forfeit the livestock as we have stated, and each of the herdsmen shall undergo the lash, and there shall be no remission for that punishment, whatever refuge they seek; and the man himself shall declare none the less who was present as witness when he bought the livestock.

Gif hit þonne ofer fif niht ungecyd on gemænre læse wunað, þolige þæs orfes swa we ǽr cwædon, ⁊ þara hyrda ælc þolige þære hyde; ⁊ þæs ne sy nán forgifnes, gesecen þæt hy gesecen; ⁊ he ðeahhwæðere cyðe, on hwæs gewitnysse he þæt orf bohte.
